name: Master
source: Master is not his real name, but he wants everyone to call him just like that. It’s never easy to grasp how he feels and what he wants and sometimes he looks like an empty shell. He leaves in the same building where his family lives but in a different floor. Bali thinks he is a emo but Master doesn’t really know what that word means. Probably this two guys has most things in common than they ever could say but their hearts are both closed. Finding a way through them looks really hard.
